blocks.text: The Module Workstation edits the modules stored inside a Flawless Calculator. The calculator component is the sole owner of the module contents; the workstation is not a second copy of the inventory.

rows: Put the Flawless Calculator in the workstation Calculator slot.
Place supported modules in the module positions, up to the server-configured limit. The shipped maximum is 16.
Remove the Flawless Calculator. Its installed modules and their inventories travel with it.
Sneak-use the calculator to cycle the selected module. The selection label tells you which action a normal use will perform.
Return to the ordinary Flawless calculation selection when you need the four-input recipes instead of a module action.

blocks.text: Atomic Assembly exposes the three-lane Dynamic Module. Flawless Assembly exposes flawless calculation. Storage remains inside its module; installed Energy Modules add storage. Installed ender pearls and grenades use FE rather than consuming the installed item.

Not every similarly named crafting component is an installable module. In particular Atomic Module is a component, not a usable workstation module. Read the live crafting references before installing or consuming rare materials.
